expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this pic? I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—**which person should the headshot feature: the person on the left or the right?**

Here are the options before spending any credits:

| Option | Listed cost | Details |
|---|---:|---|
| **Budget image edit** | **5 credits** | One square, 640px image using the free-plan Flux 2 Klein model. I can request professional clothing, a neutral studio background, and natural lighting while preserving your likeness. |
| Dedicated headshot tool | 50 credits | Requires a photo with only one detectable face, so this two-person photo isn’t suitable as-is. |

**The 5-credit edit is the cheapest listed generation option** for this request. A shorter duration doesn’t apply to a still image, and 640px is the smallest listed setting. A simple crop outside Magic Hour could cost no generation credits, but wouldn’t change the clothes, lighting, or beach background.

Nothing has run or spent credits. If you want the budget option, tell me **left or right and confirm the 5-credit spend**.
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right. For the 5-credit option, ok, go ahead with that—natural and professional, and keep my smile.

turns.agent:
The 5-credit edit was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was generated and no credits were spent.**

The cheapest listed generation option is still the one we tried: one square 640px image for 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper or smaller generation setting listed.

For a no-credit alternative, you could crop the original around you using your phone’s photo editor—though that would retain the beach background and original clothing.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a square professional headshot of ONLY the adult woman with short blonde hair on the RIGHT of the supplied photo. Remove the man entirely. Preserve her identity, recognizable facial features, short blonde hairstyle, and her original warm natural smile with visible teeth. Head-and-shoulders composition, looking at camera, centered with comfortable headroom. Natural professional appearance: tasteful navy blazer over a simple light blouse, neutral light gray studio background, soft flattering natural-looking light, realistic skin texture, minimal retouching. Photorealistic, approachable and professional. No text, no other people.
